# Deft Directive Feedback -- gap escalation to upstream

Conversational batched flow for filing framework gaps discovered during consumer sessions. Mirrors the confirmation gate from `deft-directive-article-review` -- the agent drafts and dedups; the operator approves before any upstream issue is created. House style for title/body/labels/dedup lives in [`docs/framework-gap-filing.md`](../../docs/framework-gap-filing.md).

Legend (from RFC2119): !=MUST, ~=SHOULD, ≉=SHOULD NOT, ⊗=MUST NOT, ?=MAY.

## When to Use

- Mid-session when the operator says "file a directive issue", "file this upstream", "report a framework gap", or "directive feedback" -- even while `plan.policy.valueFeedback.upstreamPrompt` is OFF
- Session end when `friction:*` ledger signals or the operator reports a directive shortfall
- After the operator opts into upstream filing via the audited setter below

## Preconditions

- ! Run only from a **consumer project** -- the filing path no-ops inside the directive maintainer repo
- ! Filing requires `plan.policy.valueFeedback.upstreamPrompt` ON. If OFF, draft with `deft feedback:file --dry-run` / `--json` (title+body still print), then ask the operator to enable via `deft policy:enable-value-feedback --confirm --upstream-prompt`. If declined, STOP safely -- do not hand-edit PROJECT-DEFINITION.
- ! Inspect current state with `deft policy:show --field=valueFeedback`
- ⊗ File upstream issues without explicit operator confirmation
- ⊗ Treat handwritten typed-block / PROJECT-DEFINITION edits as the primary audited setter

## Phase 1 -- Collect (batched)

- ! Gather concrete gap reports from the session: what was expected, what happened, and minimal reproduction context
- ! Batch multiple friction items into one upstream issue when they share a root cause; otherwise prepare separate drafts
- ~ Prefer attributed phrasing ("encoding gate blocked a valid file") over vague quality claims
- ! Follow [`docs/framework-gap-filing.md`](../../docs/framework-gap-filing.md) for title/BLOCKER, section shape, empty create labels, privileged `adoption-blocker`, dedup, and Refs

## Phase 1.5 -- Adoption-blocker judgment

- ! Ask whether the gap blocks adoption. A gap blocks adoption when the consumer cannot complete an intended Directive flow and has no reasonable workaround.
- ! When the answer is yes, collect the body evidence a privileged actor needs before applying `adoption-blocker`: affected consumer flow and version; documented alternatives attempted, or why they are not a reasonable workaround; observed recovery cost. Pass `--blocker` (and `--flow`, `--alternatives`, `--recovery-cost` when known) so the title carries `BLOCKER` and the body carries those sections.
- ! When the answer is no or unknown, omit `--blocker`. Absence of the token does not mean "not a blocker" -- it means not classified.
- ⊗ Apply or request the `adoption-blocker` ranking label from a consumer-authored title. The label is a privileged write after the body-evidence test.

## Phase 2 -- Draft + dedup

- ! For each candidate report, run a dry draft (reuse the same report fields and target repo in Phase 3; confirmation adds `--confirm` and drops `--dry-run`/`--json`):

```bash
deft feedback:file --summary "<one-line summary>" --context "<session context>" --expected "<expected>" --actual "<actual>" --notes "<optional>" [--blocker --flow "<flow and version>" --alternatives "<alts>" --recovery-cost "<cost>"] [--dry-run|--json]
```

- ! Read the printed draft title/body with the operator before proceeding
- ! If the command reports an **open** duplicate, surface the existing issue URL and the proposed evidence-comment body. Do **not** create a new issue. Proceed to Phase 3 only when the operator wants to append evidence with `--confirm` (exit 0 `commented-open-duplicate` path) — this is not a STOP-on-`blocked-duplicate` halt
- ! If the command reports a **closed** duplicate without disposition, STOP and re-run only after the operator chooses `--on-closed=comment` or `--on-closed=create-anyway` (no consumer reopen)
- ! Incomplete closed-search notes (`stopReason=window-exhausted|cap`) are disclosure, not a hard stop — keep them visible when filing
- ⊗ Proceed past an open-duplicate preview by creating a new issue
- ⊗ Silently create when a closed title match exists without `--on-closed`
- ~ When go-task is installed, the Taskfile may wrap the same verb; prefer `deft feedback:file` as primary

## Phase 3 -- Confirm + file / comment

- ! Present the final draft (or proposed evidence comment) and ask for explicit yes/no confirmation
- ! Only after approval, re-run the **same report fields and target repo** with `--confirm` added and without `--dry-run` or `--json`. Retain `--notes` / blocker evidence flags so a posted comment carries the reviewed payload:

```bash
deft feedback:file --summary "<one-line summary>" --context "<session context>" --expected "<expected>" --actual "<actual>" --notes "<optional>" [--blocker --flow "<flow>" --alternatives "<alts>" --recovery-cost "<cost>"] --confirm [--on-closed=comment|--on-closed=create-anyway]
```

- ! Open match + `--confirm` → evidence comment on the existing open issue (`commented-open-duplicate`, exit 0); print issue URL + comment URL; never `restCreateIssue`
- ! Closed match + `--on-closed=comment` → evidence comment on the closed issue; do not reopen
- ! Closed match + `--on-closed=create-anyway` → new issue body carries `Related: closed #<n>`
- ! No match → file a new upstream issue; print the filed issue URL
- ⊗ Use `Closes`/`Fixes`/`Resolves` in the upstream body -- use `Refs #1709` only
- ⊗ Auto-comment without `--confirm`

## Phase 4 -- Handoff

- ~ Record the upstream issue URL in the session handoff or continue checkpoint if the operator tracks follow-ups locally
- ~ Return to the prior workflow; gap escalation does not block story completion

## Anti-Patterns

- ⊗ Filing from the maintainer framework repo (consumer-only guard)
- ⊗ Creating a new issue when an open title match exists — confirm then comment instead
- ⊗ Treating open-match confirm as `blocked-duplicate` STOP — Prefer-A Recut-2 uses `commented-open-duplicate` exit 0
- ⊗ Writing on a closed title match without `--on-closed=comment|create-anyway`
- ⊗ Reopening a closed issue from the consumer feedback path
- ⊗ Treating `--confirm` as implicit from broad session approval -- require an explicit filing/comment confirmation step
- ⊗ Infer "not a blocker" from an unmarked report -- absence of `BLOCKER` means not classified
- ⊗ Auto-apply `adoption-blocker` from a consumer-authored title
- ⊗ Hand-editing PROJECT-DEFINITION to flip `upstreamPrompt` instead of the audited setter
